thread:
Maya K: quick poll 5: should we label theme options in the picker with microcopy? proposing: "Dark 5 Balanced" and "Dark 5 High contrast" vs "Dark (default)" / "Dark (high contrast)". thoughts?
Samir P: i prefer the dash version — reads better inline in select controls.
Ari C: dash is fine. but please avoid parens in the picker; they add cognitive load.
DesignLintBot: recommendation: use short labels for pickers, longer explanation in an info tooltip.
Maya K: good call. related: uploaded a new heatmap palette for token intensity mapping. divergent scale seems to map better to user expectations. figma link: https://figma.com/file/heatmap-abc
Samir P: looks good. small nit: legend swatches are still tiny on mobile. can we make responsive swatch sizing (12px desktop, 14px mobile)?
Ari C: yes and ensure touch targets around the legend are at least 44px.
Maya K: noted  updating tokens and touch areas. will push in next figma update.
DesignLintBot: contrast report attached.
